name: Mahalalel (son of Kenan)
title: The fifth patriarch from Adam
summary: Mahalalel was the fifth generation from Adam through the line of Seth. He lived in a time before the flood and is an important link in the genealogy leading to Noah and further to Jesus Christ. His name probably means 'praise of God'.

keyEvents.title: The birth of Mahalalel
keyEvents.description: Mahalalel was born when his father Kenan was 70 years old. He became the fifth in the lineage from Adam.

keyEvents.title: Jared is Born
keyEvents.description: When Mahalalel was 65 years old, he had a son named Jared, who would become the father of the famous Enoch.

keyEvents.title: Mahalalel's Long Life
keyEvents.description: After Jared was born, Mahalalel lived for another 830 years and had more sons and daughters. His total lifespan was 895 years.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Jesus' Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Mahalalel is included in Luke's genealogy showing Jesus' ancestry all the way back to Adam and God.
